_comment: The provider ROLE catalog. HG-0008 says the harness names roles, never vendors — but until now the only place a vendor could be named was adapters/reference/, which holds at most ONE adapter per control (AD-R05 refuses two on the same control, and CI mounts that whole directory). So a role with three plausible providers had nowhere to put the second and third: the directory encoded 'the one true instance', not 'pick one'. This catalog is the fix. Each role states the control it fills and the capability name a profile uses to REQUIRE it; providers/<role>/ holds the alternatives; docs/governance/provider-selection.json records which one this institution chose. Nothing here is mounted by default — a catalog is an offer, not an installation.

roles.purpose: Assert the dependency-audit severity counts from outside the repository under test, so the Q4 gate cannot be satisfied by an agent writing its own verdict
must_provide: severity counts (and any reachability verdict) asserted by the scanning platform, not by the scanned repo
a tamper probe: editing the local report away from the platform's counts must fail the build

roles.purpose: Make the runtime the coding agent executes in a digest-pinned, attestation-verified image, so HG-0011's attested-execution limb rests on evidence rather than on a base image nobody can account for
must_provide: a digest (never a tag) plus a verification result for the image's SBOM and provenance
a negative probe: an image without a valid attestation must fail admission
